name: canonical-page-previews
goal: Classify framework compatibility redirects as nonvisual and capture actual report components by state

evidence: Compatibility details routes canonicalize to existing entity pages and therefore have no own visual capture. They should be compact nonvisual entries. Report state captures must name only the components actually shown in that state.

The category suite assumed every +page.svelte renders a distinct page. Add all seven built-in detail aliases plus a normal app details counterexample, and capture component-specific report states through the existing reports scenario.
